main.allSettingsDefault: All Settings are already at their default values.
main.exitConfirm: Are you sure you want to exit?
main.noHistory: There is not enough history to make changes.
main.noteAccents: Note: Disabling this option removes all accented characters from the text, which may make some words harder to understand.
main.noteDecimalPlaces:
Note 1: Using too few decimal places may reduce calculation accuracy.
Note 2: Existing values will be rounded to the new number of decimal places.
main.noteDecimalSeparator2:
Note 2: This is purely cosmetic and does not affect calculations.
Note 3: You may also enter numbers using “,” instead of “.”.
main.noteDegrees:
Note 1: This affects Trigonometric Functions such as Sine, Cosine and Tangent.
Note 2: When enabled, angles are interpreted as degrees rather than π radians.
main.noteDivisionPrecision:
Note 1: This may affect calculations involving very small divisions.
Note 2: Enter the value exactly as “1e-12”.
main.noteExplanations:
Note 1: Enabling this option will display more detailed explanations for certain results, such as the Delta calculation, Δ = b² − 4 · a · c, instead of only the final result.
Note 2: Not every message has an explanatory version.
Note 3: If Unicode is disabled, the expression will be displayed as: Delta = b^2 - 4 * a * c.
main.noteInputConfirm: Note: Everything you enter will require confirmation.
main.noteIterationLimit:
Note 1: This affects all loops, including logarithms, menus and similar operations.
Note 2: It is intended to prevent infinite loops if something goes wrong.
main.noteLanguage: Note: This changes the language used throughout the entire Program.
main.noteLogPrecision:
Note 1: This may affect calculations involving very small Logarithmic values.
Note 2: Enter the value exactly as “1e-12”.
main.noteOutputConfirm: Note: A confirmation message will be displayed before closing the Program.
main.noteRestoreDefault:
Note 1: This will affect all the Settings listed above.
Note 2: This change is permanent.
main.noteSettingsExit: Note: Your Settings may be reset when the Program closes.
main.noteShowFunction:
Note 1: When enabled, the current Function (for example, ax² + bx + c) is displayed at the top of each menu.
Note 2: The Function will still be shown when option “6” (Review) is selected.
main.noteSimpleMulti:
Note 1: This changes Polynomial expressions from “a · x² + b · x + c” to “ax² + bx + c”.
Note 2: If Unicode is disabled, “·” will be replaced with “*”.
Note 3: This does not affect “×”, although Unicode will also replace it with “*”.
main.noteUnicode:
Note 1: Unicode characters are special symbols such as “ℝ”, “∀”, etc. Disabling this option will replace them with their textual equivalents, such as “Reals” and “for all”.
Note 2: Not all Unicode characters will be disabled.
Note 3: This setting may alter some explanations.
